text: يا حبيبي، شلونك؟ هسه ماكو وقت، بس باجرك كلشي تمام، وانا كمان هسي راحة قلبي، تعال قعد معي شوية.
gloss: Hey my love, how are you? Right now I don't have time, but for your sake everything is fine, and I also feel peace of heart, come sit with me for a bit.
note: written once by Qwen3.8; the same line for every attempt and renderer
